comment.name: Millard J Melnyk
comment.body:
Hear, hear!

At this point, “antisemitism” has become every bit as meaningful as any other kind of pigshit.

Totally void of intelligent, let alone sane, meaning.

It’s just something you throw and smear to make someone look bad.

People I admire left that crap behind in 8th grade.

The rest of you? I don’t have even a smidgen of respect for you and your stupidity.

At least come up with something more original and interesting, would ya?

“Antisemitism” is nothing more than a thought-terminating cliché. And you know what Lifton said about the use of TTCs, right? They’re part of the “psychology of totalism”. They’re part of brainwashing. In today’s vernacular, they’re a key mechanism in PSYOPs. 

They’re the province of cultists and cult creators.

So, to all cultists of whichever ilk, including Jewish cultists: just fuck the fuck off.

Mkay?
